'''Palauka Cybernetics''', also referred to as simply '''Palauka''', was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] company that manufactured implants and prosthetic [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. During the [[Sith Wars/Legends|ongoing struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], there were reports of malfunctioning Palauka implants and prosthetics, so the company shut down its production in order to investigate.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Extended Warranty" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an individual associated with one of the two sides in the ongoing struggle sent a companion of theirs to assist Palauka Cybernetics. The companion helped Palauka's [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] discover a software fault and subsequently wrote an entirely new software suite for them. As a result, Palauka was very generous to the companion.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Palauka Cybernetics was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Extended Warranty" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed.<ref name="Mission" />
